== Summary ==
Slip “Echo Base Trooper” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 969, 581, 1253)). Version [[Echo Base Trooper (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
